notes: PLACEHOLDER ATOM (extracted 2026-05-14 from FormField). Custom text caret + sticky 'sign here' arrow tab pointing at the active form field. The caret <span> is injected at runtime by src/lib/caret/custom-caret.ts — there is no server-rendered markup. Caret.astro is a no-op placeholder that exists so the schema/renderer pipeline has a target. Class names (.form-field__caret, .form-field__arrow-tab) are still coupled to the JS string literals — future cleanup will rename to .caret / .caret__arrow and decouple. Activated by data-custom-caret on <html>. Gates: data-hover, data-render, data-enhanced-focus, data-caret-shape, data-focus-rainbow.

content._description: Caret has no content props — it's a visual indicator injected by JS based on focused input position.

colour._description: Caret colour bridges --caret-color (set on .form-field). JS sets it per-instance when data-focus-rainbow is on (custom-caret.ts line 96-101).

shape._description: Caret shape variant. Set via data-caret-shape on <html>. 'line' = default thin vertical bar. 'block' = 0.6em wide with 0.5 opacity. 'circle' = circular dot.
shape._note: Implicit baseline is 'line' (no data-caret-shape attribute). Omit to use.

thickness._description: Caret stroke width. Set via data-enhanced-focus (medium=4px) or data-render='assistive' (thick=6px). Default thin uses --border-width-2.
thickness._note: No author prop — driven by accessibility gates, not per-instance config.

blink._description: Blink speed. Driven by data-hover gate: full=standard (--duration-long), gentle=slow pulse (--duration-continuous-slow), instant/none=off.
blink._note: No author prop — driven by hover gate.
